review_description: Had a 6.6Kw system, installed with Sungrow 5Kw Inverter and Seraphim 330w Blade panels, Been running now for around 18mths with zero issues and producing good energy.We were recently selected for a random audit and the inspector said its one of the cleanest and nicest installs he's seen, no issue to report at all which is very encouraging.Response can be a little slow but once engaged were really helpful and obliging even discussing various inverter options before committing to what we chose
